title: Underwater Train Station
one_sentence: A glass-tube transit platform beneath the sea, built as a multi-room Wonder seed with clear expansion hooks.
source_prompt: An underwater train station with arched glass tunnels, a stopped bathysphere train, red signal lamps, coral growth, and a sealed service hatch behind the platform.

intent.setting: A submerged transit station with a main platform, glass concourse, and service threshold.
intent.emotional_goal: The space should feel calm, sealed, and slightly vulnerable to the ocean outside.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the stopped train and decide whether to open the sealed service hatch.
intent.spatial_logic: The platform runs beside the train, with tunnel mouths and service spaces branching from the main concourse.

style.lighting: Caustic blue window light mixes with red signal lamps and small platform fixtures.

required_elements.description: A ribbed glass station shell that reveals the ocean outside.
A rounded undersea train stopped beside the platform.
Readable route markers along the station platform.
Signal lamps that still glow red at the far tunnel.
A locked hatch to a maintenance room below the platform.
Controlled coral forms creeping along one quiet platform edge.

camera_intents.purpose: Show the platform, glass tube, and stopped train together.
Inspect the locked service hatch and signal reflections.

curiosity_goals: Why did the train stop under the sea?
What is behind the sealed service hatch?
Why are the red signal lamps still powered?
authoring_notes: Phase 32 JSON-only Wonder example focused on environment modules, transit readability, and underwater material language.
